page.notes: The word "tētia" at the start and the numeral "27" beside it are copied as best as I can read; the spacing in "2 7" is uncertain. The mark "q" after "loquitur" is doubtful, marked [?]. The small "O" printed on the last line, left of "toris", is not a word and is left out; "toris" completes "Impera-toris". The reference mark "q" in the text is matched by the margin note with the same letter. Long s is copied as s throughout. The "1" of the printed note marker in "loquitur" was read as a "q" with a query.
